applies_why: The judge text evaluates a collision on Matthew 1:20 between the challenger's and defender's readings, so the rule governing chain-against-chain weighing applies.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
why: The judge labels the Matthew 1:20 dispute underdetermined by noting each side's answer, without weighing the challenger's and defender's chains by footing as K-C requires.
